item.description: After being shown off at the Philippine International Motor Show last June and the Bangkok International Motor Show last March , Nissan Philippines is almost ready to commence retail sales of its much awaited all-new Kicks e-Power. Read More »

item.title: 2027 Ford Territory Hybrid Platinum Approved For Philippine Launch
item.description: Ford Philippines is poised to add a third variant to its best-selling Territory Hybrid this August. This based on homologation papers the carmaker has filed with both the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and the Department of Energy (DOE). Read More »

item.title: Honda Cars PH Extends Hybrid Vehicle Offers This July
item.description: Honda is keeping itself relevant in the Philippines by continue to offer slews of discounts for the month of July. Extending its “Hybrid Power, Honda Trust” promotion, Honda is offering low monthly amortizations and all-in down payments for the HR-V RS e:HEV, Civic RS e:HEV, and CR-V RS e:HEV AWD. R
